instruction.text: This picture shows a film set. Do you know what each of these objects are? Fill in the correct word.
What is a green screen used for? Choose the correct explanation.

b: ++Green screens can make it look like the actors are somewhere without having to film in that location.
Green screens are used to remove all distractions in the background of a scene.

instruction.text: What is a clapperboard used for? Choose the correct explanation.

b: ++A clapperboard makes a loud clapping sound and helps filmmakers piece together the film after taping it.
The clapperboard tells the audience when to clap. Clapping is only allowed when the clapperboard is used.

atoms.sound: ssml: So, Claire, I have been thinking about how we are going to film this first scene. A green screen can’t help us make it look like Joth and Loyt are in outer space which means we will really have to film in outer space, right? Filming will be so exciting!

atoms.b: “We_will_use_clapperboards,_won’t_we? I_would_love_to_be_the_one_to_use_the_clapperboard_in_the_very_first_scene,_that_would_be_such_an_honour. ((Also, I’ve been seeing crew members carry in some lighting equipment which we surely will not need.))”
atoms.sound: ssml: We will use clapperboards, won’t we? I would love to be the one to use the clapperboard in the very first scene. <break time='400ms'/> That would be such an honour. Also, I’ve been seeing crew members carry in some lighting equipment which we surely will not need.
